description: [JIP-3] Core analysis — status, utilization, validators, and bottlenecks

panels.description: [JIP-3] Guarantee event counts per core over time — shows which cores are actively producing guarantees and relative load distribution. Each line is one core's count per interval. (From core_stats_1m)
panels.title: Guarantees by Core

panels.description: [JIP-3] Network-wide failure events broken down by type: WorkPackageFailed, WorkPackageSharingFailed, and other failure/discard events. Stacked to show total failure volume. (1-minute buckets from event_stats_1m)
panels.title: Failures by Type

panels.description: [JIP-3] Per-core summary: work packages received, guarantees produced, and failures — one row per core. Use to spot underperforming or overloaded cores at a glance.
panels.title: Core Status Grid

panels.description: [JIP-3] Key pipeline metrics for this core: total work packages, failure rate, and average end-to-end pipeline latency in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Pipeline Stats

panels.description: [JIP-3] 100 most recent work packages on this core with full pipeline timestamps: received, authorized, refined, report built, guarantee built, distributed, and failure time. Use for timeline analysis of individual WPs.
panels.title: Core Work Packages

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50 and P95 latency for each pipeline stage on this core: authorize, refine, report, guarantee, distribute. Identifies which stage is the bottleneck. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Stage Timing (ms)

panels.description: [JIP-3] Failure events on this core broken down by type. Each series is a distinct failure event type. Use to identify recurring failure patterns on this core. (1-minute buckets)
panels.title: Core Failures by Type

panels.description: [JIP-3] All event types on this core shown as stacked bars — total event volume composition over time. Each color band is one event type. (1-minute buckets)
panels.title: Core Events by Type

panels.description: [JIP-3] Work package pipeline funnel — shows how many WPs reach each stage.
panels.title: WP Pipeline Funnel

panels.description: [JIP-3] Work package pipeline stage counts per time bucket for core ${core_index}. Stacked bars show how many WPs reached each stage: WorkPackageReceived(94) → Authorized(95) → Refined(101) → WorkReportBuilt(102) → GuaranteeBuilt(105) → GuaranteesDistributed(109). Failed shows WorkPackageFailed(92). Drop-off between stages indicates pipeline issues. (From wp_tracking, bucketed by first_seen)
panels.title: WP Funnel — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 latency for the authorize stage on core ${core_index}. Measures WorkPackageReceived(94) → Authorized(95) delta in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Authorize — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 latency for the refine stage on core ${core_index}. Measures Authorized(95) → Refined(101) delta in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Refine — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 latency for the report stage on core ${core_index}. Measures Refined(101) → WorkReportBuilt(102) delta in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Report — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 latency for the guarantee stage on core ${core_index}. Measures WorkReportBuilt(102) → GuaranteeBuilt(105) delta in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Guarantee — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 latency for the distribute stage on core ${core_index}. Measures GuaranteeBuilt(105) → GuaranteesDistributed(109) delta in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Distribute — Core ${core_index}

panels.description: [JIP-3] P50/P95 end-to-end pipeline latency on core ${core_index}. Measures WorkPackageReceived(94) → GuaranteesDistributed(109) or last update, in ms. (From wp_tracking)
panels.title: Pipeline Total — Core ${core_index}

title: TART Cores (JIP-3)
